_comment: Qwen-Image (20B DiT) txt2img in ComfyUI API format, run as a pre-quantized GGUF so it fits 16 GB VRAM (diffusers on-the-fly bnb quant OOMs — see models.yaml). Needs the city96/ComfyUI-GGUF custom node. The image-forge ComfyUI backend substitutes the %TOKENS% before POSTing; %CKPT% names the GGUF in ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models (set backend checkpoint='qwen-image-Q4_K_M.gguf'). Text encoder (qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled) and VAE (qwen_image_vae) live in models/text_encoders and models/vae. Qwen uses true CFG, so the negative prompt is honoured. Steps/cfg tuned for the rich painterly D-011 register (vs the flatter Qwen default): 30 steps @ cfg 4.0, euler/simple, ModelSamplingAuraFlow shift 3.1. The riverflow-look lighting/detail cues live in the example's QWEN_STYLE booster, not here.
